title: Leelanau Pontoon Rentals
specs: Fleet of three Sweetwater Pontoons, 2016 and newer, with at least 90hp motors
Bring coastguard approved lifejackets for children 12 and under
Boats hold at least 10 persons; two boats hold up to 12 persons
includes: Basic life jackets and all safety equipment provided onboard
Full tank of gas at start of rental
blurb: Guests rent pontoon boats to captain themselves on Lake Leelanau. Boats hold 10 to 12 persons and include safety equipment and amenities like cup holders and bimini covers. Rentals are typically 7.5 hours, with options for multi-day discounts and delivery to various launch sites.
extraNote: Full day deposit required to secure reservation · At least 30 days notice for full refund on cancellation · 50% refund if cancelled 5 to 30 days prior, or option to reschedule · No refund if cancelled less than 5 days prior or no-show · Full refund if weather deemed unsafe by operator · $200 cleaning fee if boat returned in disarray · Gas used is paid by renter; ethanol free marine grade fuel required · Meet at selected boat ramp (Bingham Boat Launch, Narrows Boat Launch, or Alpers Rd/East Leland Boat Launch)
